title: Speed up type checks and assignments used with typed containers types
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Improves multi-threading performance for couple of basic operations used with typed containers.
- Also improves the performance of the type check and assignment with typed containers in a single thread.

## Additional information

~~Original PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122723~~ Kind of only the idea is now the same

### GDScript VM changes

The script pointer is extracted directly because it is already being extracted in the same way for similar operations in a couple of different opcodes:
- `OPCODE_TYPE_TEST_SCRIPT`
- `OPCODE_ASSIGN_TYPED_SCRIPT`
- `OPCODE_CAST_TO_SCRIPT`
- `OPCODE_RETURN_TYPED_SCRIPT`

The opcodes with changes:
- `OPCODE_TYPE_TEST_ARRAY`
- `OPCODE_TYPE_TEST_DICTIONARY`
- `OPCODE_ASSIGN_TYPED_ARRAY`
- `OPCODE_ASSIGN_TYPED_DICTIONARY`
- `OPCODE_RETURN_TYPED_ARRAY`
- `OPCODE_RETURN_TYPED_DICTIONARY`

### The reason why the old code is slow

- Variant uses `Variant::evaluate(OP_EQUAL)` when comparing 2 objects for equality, which is triple inderection `operator_evaluator_table[p_op][type_a][type_b]` and C++ can't inline the call in this situation.
- `OperatorEvaluatorEqualObject` is really slow in multi-threading, 2 global locks (through `Variant::get_validated_object -> ObjectDB::get_instance`) really slows down the multi-threading.
- Can cause contention over the same atomic when the `StringName` is returned by the value.

## Benchmark

The results are in tables with numbers measuring `ns/op`. The number in the column indicate how many threads were used for that run, 0 is a main thread. Each run had the same workload that was split between all running threads (this simulates parallel workload). Only tested using release templates.

Compile command: `scons target=template_release optimize=speed accesskit=no use_llvm=yes linker=lld production=yes`

Project: [testthreads4.6_2026-09-24_16-53-50.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32599561/testthreads4.6_2026-09-24_16-53-50.zip)

func func_type_check_builtin(count: int) -> int:

    var time_end := Time.get_ticks_usec()
    finished.emit.call_deferred(time_end - time_start)
    return sum
